label: mid-copy steps (recall 3+, 2+ outputs left) with certain input tokens (i,o,x,f,d,r,h,m,...)
explanation: Fires only in the copy phase: never on original tokens or <DEL>, and essentially never at recall_idx 0-1. Most mass is in the middle of the copy, at recall_idx 3-4 (77% of mass) with at least 2 outputs still to come; the rate falls near the end of the copy (to_go 0-1) and for short sequences (zero for L<=4). Within that window it is strongly selective for the input token, a graded preference with i > o > x > f > d > r > h/m > z/n/e/0. Top activations are almost all on input i or o around steps 11-12 of L=8-9 sequences. Position alone (recall>=3, to_go>=2) gets recall 0.79 at precision 0.31; adding the token set raises precision to about 0.6 but drops recall, because the token preference is graded rather than a clean set.
